name: Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: ATS/ERS/JRS/ALAT Clinical Practice Guideline for IPF Diagnosis

criteria.description: Progressive exertional dyspnea and chronic dry cough in adults over 50 years
High-resolution CT showing usual interstitial pneumonia (UIP) pattern
Exclusion of other known causes of interstitial lung disease such as connective tissue disease, drug toxicity, or environmental exposures
Surgical lung biopsy showing UIP pattern when HRCT is inconclusive
Restrictive ventilatory defect and reduced diffusing capacity for carbon monoxide (DLCO)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of typical clinical presentation, UIP pattern on HRCT, and exclusion of other causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Lung biopsy reserved for cases with indeterminate HRCT findings

pathognomonic.notes: Audible on auscultation, especially at lung bases
searchTerms: soft crackling noises when breathing in
worsening shortness of breath with activity

rare.notes: Due to pulmonary hypertension or hypoxemia

laboratory: Normal or mildly elevated inflammatory markers (ESR, CRP)
Exclusion of autoimmune serologies (ANA, RF, anti-CCP) to rule out connective tissue disease
imaging: High-resolution CT showing basal and subpleural predominant reticular opacities with honeycombing and traction bronchiectasis consistent with UIP pattern
Absence of features suggestive of alternative diagnoses (e.g., extensive ground-glass opacities)
genetic: Mutations in genes such as TERT, TERC, and surfactant protein genes in familial cases
other: Pulmonary function tests showing restrictive pattern with reduced total lung capacity and decreased DLCO

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of lymphocytosis in bronchoalveolar lavage
Systemic symptoms such as arthritis, rash
Bilateral hilar lymphadenopathy on chest imaging

redFlags: Acute exacerbation with new bilateral ground-glass opacities
references: Raghu G, et al. An Official ATS/ERS/JRS/ALAT Clinical Practice Guideline: Treatment of Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis. Am J Respir Crit Care Med. 2015.
American Thoracic Society. Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis: Diagnosis and Treatment. 2011.
King TE Jr, et al. Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. Lancet. 2011.
